name: Loading Morph
summary: The button owns the wait: the label blurs into the system spinner, then the result glyph springs in, all inside one fixed frame. No haptic on entering loading; .success lands as the checkmark settles (+0.18 s), .error fires at once.

accessibility.reduceMotion: cross-fades only: no blur, no scale; same timings; haptics at the same moments
accessibility.voiceOver: label names the action ("Checkout") and never changes; loadingLabel ("Checking out…") is the value while loading; both strings injectable, nothing hard-coded

sources: Apple, Human Interface Guidelines: Buttons (activity indicator inside the button, "Checkout" → "Checking out…")
Family, morphing button label (Benji Taylor, "Family Values", 2024)
Emil Kowalski, 7 Practical Animation Tips: blur as the bridge between two states

states.motion: label at rest in a frame already sized for the widest state; returning from any phase is a 160 ms cross-fade
label blurs out (opacity 1→0, blur 0→4 pt) over 120 ms easeOut; system spinner (.small, 14 pt) fades in over 120 ms from +40 ms
states.haptic: none: the user just pressed and knows

states.motion: outgoing content fades out over 100 ms; checkmark scales 0.6→1 on spring 0.28/0.72 while fading in over 120 ms
states.haptic: .success at +180 ms, as the glyph settles (full size at 152 ms, crest at 202 ms); dropped if the phase changes first

states.motion: same as success, with an xmark
states.haptic: .error at +0 ms, before any visual work: failure never waits
